description: This file defines a CKEDITOR dialog plugin for creating and editing 'radio' input elements within the CKEditor rich text editor. It registers a dialog named 'radio' with configuration for displaying, setting attributes, and handling the creation of radio button input elements.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Handles dialog display logic, selecting an existing radio input element if available.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles saving the dialog data by creating or updating a radio input element.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Populates dialog fields based on the selected radio input element.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Saves dialog input values into the radio input element attributes.
